question: If $\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\5&7\end{vmatrix}=-1$, determine the value of $\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\2&3\end{vmatrix}$ without expanding it.
explanation:
Step 1: Compare the determinants
In the second determinant, the first and second rows of the original determinant have been interchanged.
Step 2: Use the relevant property
When any two rows of a determinant are interchanged, the sign of the determinant changes.
Step 3: Apply the property
Therefore, $$\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\2&3\end{vmatrix}=-\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\5&7\end{vmatrix}$$
Step 4: Substitute the given value
Using the given determinant value, $$\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\2&3\end{vmatrix}=-(-1)=1$$
Hence, the required value is $1$.
